first_fault_reasoning: Qualified current-owner cause is combinationally visible immediately and registered once; later higher-priority faults cannot overwrite terminal_valid. Simultaneous priority is reconstruction/inverse/coefficient.
full_campaign_api_observation: The original full bench arms new-frame core_starts monitoring immediately after public acceptance, but raw leaf diagnostics reset only at E+1 child delivery. A new-version one-edge API wait before monitor_active (with poison before delivery and all original checks retained) aligns the declared interval; first focused physical tests began after abort and did not cover success-to-next-admission stale diagnostics.
open_scope: No native timing result yet: qualified_fault to transfer_enable and returned producer ready may remain a long combinational path.
Prepared fault/sequence fixtures are explicit adversarial verification states, not claims of packet reachability.

Focused physical cancellations use external abort/reset; peer fault during a live queued/private replay response is not independently closed by those four checks and should remain visible to the full campaign/new owner ledger.
Legacy external tags require drained/quiescent session assumptions to avoid same-tag duplicate aliasing across reset; full PCTL1 is not implemented.
peer_kill_reasoning: Only the first current peer fault can schedule producer kill; self-coefficient failure preserves its original counters and local drain. Sequence comparison rejects a stale registered kill.
pending_delivery_reasoning: One slot; E acceptance snapshots all10 command groups; accepted_start delivers only E+1 unless external kill. No old child fault can qualify while owner_delivered is false.
physical_drain_reasoning: The four actual physical tests retain accepted request owners across abort/reset and blocked replacement until matching responses; raw memory/reference response channels are not gated by revocation.
reservation_reasoning: Credit created only from all_available; thereafter only command_accept or cache_accept can allocate reserved resources. Cache partial owns reservation, terminal/abort recredit cannot arise from a delivered live frame.
